description: Tunable weights and constants for risk scoring, confidence math, verification planning, budget allocation, and workflow criticality. Override at .veris/data/risk-config.json. Every number visible and explainable.

risk._formula: overallRisk = weights.blastRadius x blastRadius + weights.dependencyFragility x inboundDominance + weights.runtimeCriticality x runtimeCriticality. blastRadius = blastRadiusMax x (1 - exp(-blastRadiusPerEdge x degree / blastRadiusMax)), degree counted over coupling edges only (class-to-own-method containment excluded). inboundDominance = Laplace-smoothed share of coupling pointing INTO the node, rescaled so balanced or outbound-heavy scores 0. dependencyFragility in the output carries inboundDominance.

planning._note: Thresholds deciding which verification work gets planned. All are INCLUSIVE minimums: a score equal to the threshold clears it. Measured range of overallRisk under the current risk formula is 10.5 (isolated, uncritical node) to 100, so a threshold at or below 10.5 excludes nothing and is not a control. probeMinOverallRisk 25 sits above the 22.65 a generic node with four balanced edges scores and below the 29.75 an isolated auth/payment-named node scores, so probes follow criticality or real coupling rather than mere presence in the diff.

budget._calibration: tierLeverage is held proportional to tierCostSeconds so leverage-per-second is identical across tiers. Any other ratio hides a per-tier constant in the ranking: at 1/3/7 against 5/30/120 the densities were 1 : 0.5 : 0.29, so greedy selection drained cheap structural checks before reaching adversarial ones. Ranking is now driven by risk x workflow criticality alone.
